summary: Skratch pulls on the Reversal Summon banner during the third anniversary event to acquire the exclusive legendary hero Child of Chaos and his exclusive artifact. Despite receiving a minor pre-release nerf to his skill set, Child of Chaos remains a very strong hero worth pulling for. The session resulted in several off-target legendary duplicates including Donella, Sagomir, and Talwer before securing Child of Chaos and Solmo within 300 summons. Players are advised to plan their Heliolite Dice carefully with upcoming banners such as Serpentemis and Talethia on the horizon.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Received a minor kit nerf prior to release, but remains very effective and high-value.

heroes.name: Donella
heroes.note: Considered one of the weakest options on the banner with minimal relevance in the current meta.

heroes.name: Sagomir
heroes.note: Provides little added value once core inspiration copies are already owned.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: A solid legendary pull primarily useful for hero inspiration upgrades.

meta_changes: Child of Chaos received minor skill adjustments and nerfs prior to his official banner release.
tips: Plan your Heliolite Dice reserve carefully as upcoming banners feature high-priority heroes like Serpentemis and Talethia.
Utilize active rebate events like Starlit Delights when topping up to gain extra bonus Heliolite Dice and resources.
title: I Whaled Out For The Child Of Chaos! What a Rollercoaster... Dragonheir: Silent Gods
